explanation: The deepest form of care that is patient, kind, not envious or arrogant, but endures all things and believes all things.
The ability to endure difficulties without becoming angry or giving up.
Showing goodness, kindness, and care for other people.
The feeling of envy over others' happiness or success that love does not allow itself to have.
A state where one is proud in a negative way; love does not seek its own honor.
The act of doing something, here used to mean that love never does what harms or offends others.
The quality of love actively pursuing the best for others rather than its own advantage.
The feeling of joy; love does not rejoice over wrongdoing, but rejoices with the truth.
The act of hiding or protecting others' faults and weaknesses instead of exposing them publicly.
Trust that everything is possible; love has unconditional faith in the good within others.
The feeling of expectation for something good in the future that never ends, even when everything looks dark.
The quality of withstanding and bearing burdens over time without giving up or losing hope.
A word emphasizing that love's nature is eternal and infinite; it never ceases to exist.
One of the charismatic gifts mentioned in the letter, often understood as a supernatural ability to speak languages one has not learned.
God-given insights or predictions about the future; these will one day cease when the perfect comes.
Experience and understanding that people acquire, but which is limited compared to God's perfect knowledge.
A state of perfection where everything is revealed and no partial insight is needed anymore; then the temporary will cease.
